title: FITASC: how the international federation was born
summary: FITASC was founded in 1921 and is based in Paris today. What the federation does for Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting, and why it matters to a beginner.

body.html: FITASC is short for the French name Fédération Internationale de Tir aux Armes Sportives de Chasse. In English that is roughly the International Federation for Shooting with Sporting Hunting Guns. The name shows its roots in hunting.

The federation was founded on 4 June 1921 in Lausanne, Switzerland. Its first name was the International Union of Hunting (UIC). National groups from ten countries in Europe, Africa and America took part in the first meeting. They wanted one set of rules, so that shooters from different countries could compete against each other on equal terms.

The General Assembly (the meeting of all its member organisations) renamed the union FITASC in 1938, and the name has stayed. Its headquarters are in Paris. That is why some sources say FITASC was founded in Paris: Paris is its home, but the founding meeting was held in Lausanne.
FITASC brings together the national federations of many countries. A shooter is usually not a direct member: you join a club and a national federation, and the federation is a member of FITASC.
FITASC's main job is the rules. It writes and updates the international rules of Parcours de Chasse – Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting. Many national federations base their own events on these rules.

FITASC also keeps the international calendar and decides where and when the World and European Championships are held. It approves the layouts of international Sporting™ competitions. And it keeps an eye on the referees: the chief referee of an international event needs a FITASC qualification.
How the sport is organised today, from the club to world level: FITASC and how international shooting is organised.

key_points.html: FITASC was founded on 4 June 1921 in Lausanne, Switzerland; its headquarters are in Paris.
Its members are national federations, not individual shooters.
FITASC writes the rules of Sporting™ and Compak® Sporting and keeps the international calendar.

did_you_know.html: FITASC got its present name in 1938. For its first 17 years it was the International Union of Hunting.

quiz.q: Where was the founding meeting of FITASC held in 1921?
quiz.explain: The founding meeting was in Lausanne on 4 June 1921; Paris is FITASC's home today.

quiz.q: Who are the members of FITASC?
quiz.explain: FITASC unites national federations; a shooter belongs to a club and to their own federation.
